port.description: TCP port LIO's iSCSI portal listens on internally. When exposing this block with network.ports[].expose: EXPOSE_VIP, this must differ from the exposed portal port (3260, the one initiators connect to) and match target_port instead — the VIP holder's own listen check collides with LIO's portal on whichever node the VIP moves to (always this block's own node, by SINGLETON's design) if the two share a port

iqn.description: Explicit target IQN override. Left unset, a stable IQN is derived once from the block instance's own name (PHASE-04-TASKS.md D4) — identical across every failover, never regenerated or tied to a node

wwn.description: Explicit backstore NAA WWN override — the identifier initiators see as the LUN's own device identity across every failover. Left unset, derived the same deterministic way as iqn

chapUser.description: CHAP username required at login. Unset means no authentication (demo mode) — mirrors share/smb's guestOk posture

chapPassword.description: CHAP secret (the iSCSI spec requires at least 12 bytes). Required when chapUser is set
